note: the smoke sentence: a two-syllable noun is one word; the adverb quá (R) is not mineable by default

sentence: Bác sĩ bây giờ có thể thản nhiên báo tin bệnh nhân bị ung thư.
note: underthesea's own doc sentence: compounds join (bác sĩ, bệnh nhân, ung thư); bây giờ is one pronoun-tagged (P) word and có thể one adverb (R), neither mineable

sentence: Trần Thị Bích Hằng là bác sĩ ở bệnh viện này.
note: a whole personal name is one Np token and Np is not mineable

sentence: Cô ấy đẹp đẽ lắm, nhìn lung linh quá.
note: reduplicatives stay one word; cô is a kinship/pronoun stopword

sentence: Anh ơi, con mèo này đẹp quá!
note: anh (tagged N) and the classifier con (Nc) are on the stopword list; the stopword tier wins over the classifier tag

sentence: Tôi mua hai con cá và ba cái bàn.
note: a classifier off the stopword list (cái, Nc) is mineable; numerals (M) and pronouns (P) are not
a shouted line is tagged lower-cased (QUÁ is Np raw, R lowered) and its fronts are lower case
new-style tone placement in the cue: the front is the canonical old style
the old-style twin of vi08 mines the same front
the front keeps its y spelling; only the lookup ladder tries kĩ thuật

sentence: Sức khoẻ của mẹ tôi không tốt.
note: the engine reads the new-style copy, so sức khỏe stays one word (fed old style it splits into sức + khỏe)

sentence: Mày đi đâu đấy? Tao đang chờ mày mà!
note: the CRF glues ? onto Tao when fed the raw line; the punctuation piece is split off before tagging

sentence: Ðây là thành phố Ðà Nẵng.
note: the Icelandic eth (U+00D0) typed for Đ is repaired by normalize; the city is Np
kinship pronouns em/anh are stopwords whatever their tag (both come back N)

sentence: Ông bà ơi, cháu về rồi ạ.
note: the compound ông bà (grandparents) is a noun, not the single-word stopwords ông and bà
